## Release invariants

- Apply scripts in ascending target-version order; never edit an already released script or jump by changing `dai_schema_metadata.version`.
- Validate the target database backup, migration result, and application compatibility before restoring traffic.
- A new migration must update `init.sql`, `internal/db/schema.go`, and this generated inventory in the same change.
- `go run ./cmd/checkschema` is the structural gate; empty-baseline replay and previous-version integration tests remain release validation work.
